performance.limits: Repeated lab samples and event maxima are diagnostics, not field p75 INP or human/physical-phone evidence.
performance.provenanceNote: Measured after all loading/menu optimizations and before the final definition-list dd/span semantic repair. Final build and accessibility/interaction checks include that repair. No loading logic changed afterward.

accessibility.scope: Compiled isolated QA, Chrome axe WCAG2.2 tags at 1440/390/320 CSS px and reduced motion; not human screen-reader or physical-device testing.

interactions.limitations: Automation only. No form submission, publication or external message. Narrow-viewport reflow does not replace native browser zoom, human assistive technology or physical devices. CSS zoom was rejected as a proxy because it does not trigger viewport media queries.

mediaMotion.scope: Local compiled image and motion regression guards adopted for C6; not a field-performance certificate. Initial visible images only; 200KB each, selected width <=1.5x displayed device pixels with 640px floor, timed entrance <=1s once, native scroll timelines separate; reuse of an already loaded larger visible image is exempt from width guard, reduced motion static.

sourceProfile.scope: Read-only direct queries from this computer to the isolated QA database; no documents or connection details recorded.

excludedEvidence: Provisional Studio scans redirected to login and are excluded. CSS zoom was rejected as a native-zoom proxy. Final scans assert exact routes and actual Studio controls.
